newsitem.title: TURKEY: Three new listings on Istanbul stock exchange.
newsitem.headline: Three new listings on Istanbul stock exchange.

text.p: Three companies listed part of their share capital on the Istanbul Stock Exchange on Thursday.
The companies were children's wear producer Ceylan Giyim Sanayi, castings firm Demisas Dokum Emaye Mamulleri and insurance firm Ray Sigorta.
Ceylan started trading at 15,500 lira, Demisas at 9,000 lira and Ray Sigorta 5,500 lira per 1,000 lira nominal valued share.
Public offers of shares in the three companies were made between July 10 and July 14.

Demisas, 53.3 percent owned by electrolytic copper wire producer Sarkuysan, raised its share capital 20 percent to 600 billion lire by selling shares with a nominal value of 100 billion lira to 17,070 investors.
Ray Sigorta sold shares with a nominal value of 98.55 billion lira from its current share capital of 657 billion lira to 4,894 investors.
Istanbul-based Ray Sigorta is owned by Turkey's media and finance group Dogan Holding A.S..
Ceylan sold shares with a nominal value of 37 billion lira to 1,775 investors, raising its share capital to 185 billion lira.
